title: UniPrompt-CL: Efficient Single-Inference Continual Learning for Medical Image Classification
abstract: arXiv:2508.10954v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Medical AI systems must remain reliable as data distributions shift across hospitals, imaging devices, and patient populations, yet privacy constraints often prevent storing or revisiting past patient data. We present UniPrompt-CL, a rehearsal-free domain-incremental learning framework for medical image classification using a single backbone and a single inference. Rather than relying on multiple backbones, repeated ViT inferences, or independent layer-wise prompt pools, UniPrompt-CL shares a unified prompt pool across transformer layers and expands it with only a few prompts per new domain. This reduces cross-layer redundancy while enabling efficient adaptation. On diabetic retinopathy, UniPrompt-CL improves average accuracy by 2.0 percentage points and substantially reduces forgetting relative to the strongest backbone-matched baseline. On skin cancer, it achieves competitive accuracy at the lowest training cost among DINOv2-B conf

translated_title: UniPrompt-CL：面向医学图像分类的高效单次推理持续学习
translated_abstract: 医学AI系统必须在数据分布随医院、成像设备和患者群体变化时保持可靠性，然而隐私限制通常阻止存储或重新访问过往患者数据。我们提出UniPrompt-CL，这是一个无需回放（rehearsal-free）的域增量学习框架，用于医学图像分类，仅使用单一主干网络和单次推理。与依赖多个主干网络、重复的ViT推理或独立的逐层提示池不同，UniPrompt-CL在Transformer各层之间共享统一的提示池，并仅为每个新领域添加少量提示来对其进行扩展。这减少了跨层冗余，同时实现了高效适配。在糖尿病视网膜病变任务上，与最强的主干匹配基线相比，UniPrompt-CL将平均准确率提高了2.0个百分点，并显著减少了遗忘。在皮肤癌任务上，它在DINOv2-B配置中以最低的训练成本实现了具有竞争力的准确率。
tldr: UniPrompt-CL是一种无需回放的域增量学习框架，通过在Transformer各层共享统一提示池并以单一主干网络、单次推理的方式实现医学图像分类的高效持续学习，在糖尿病视网膜病变和皮肤癌任务上以更低的训练成本取得了更高准确率并显著减少遗忘。
en_tdlr: UniPrompt-CL is a rehearsal-free domain-incremental learning framework that shares a unified prompt pool across transformer layers using a single backbone and a single inference, achieving higher accuracy, substantially reduced forgetting, and the lowest training cost on medical image classification benchmarks.
